description: EUR 3M Euribor projection curve: Euribor deposits for the short end (fixing days 2, TARGET, ModifiedFollowing, Actual/360), FRAs and/or 3M Euribor futures (future_months 3, convexity adjustment stated explicitly), and vanilla swaps vs 3M Euribor with an annual 30/360 ModifiedFollowing fixed leg on TARGET. Curve Actual365Fixed / LogLinear / Discount.
